title: A temporary river shuttle route
passage: Friday’s river shuttle skips Market Street for the fair. The sports centre is closer, but its path has steps. Riverside Gate has a level path. Folded bikes can go on any shuttle. Other bikes need a trailer. The first shuttle has none; the next does. Evening departures stay on schedule, but rides may take ten minutes longer. Train times haven’t changed.
passageZh: 星期五市集期間，河岸接駁車不停靠市場街。運動中心較近，但沿路有階梯；河岸入口的路是平的。折疊後的自行車可搭任何一班；其他自行車需要拖車。首班車沒掛拖車，下一班有。傍晚仍照表發車，但車程可能多十分鐘。火車時刻維持不變。
